3. **Proto RPC definition:** `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)`
4. **Connect handler:** `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` — `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo()` (thin wrapper delegating to the service)
5. **Service implementation:** `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `APIV1Service.CreateMemo()` (validates, builds `store.Memo`, calls `s.Store.CreateMemo`)
6. **Store method:** `store/memo.go` — `Store.CreateMemo()` (validates UID, delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`)
7. **Dialect driver (e.g. SQLite):** `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — `DB.CreateMemo()` (executes `INSERT INTO memo ... RETURNING id, created_ts, updated_ts, row_status`)
